questions.text: One horse-sized duck or a hundred duck-sized horses. Explain your battle plan in detail.
What crime would you be alarmingly good at, purely hypothetically, officer?
Invent the worst possible superpower that's still technically a superpower.
You're now a cereal mascot. What are you, what's the cereal called, and what's your catchphrase?
You're entering a wrestling ring. Music, outfit, entrance move — give us the full walkout.
Aliens abduct you and can only return you to one place on Earth, at random. What do you tell them to make sure it's somewhere good?
Invent a completely harmless conspiracy theory that people would absolutely believe.
You must live one week as a household object. Which one, and where in the house are you positioned?
Pitch the worst restaurant concept you can imagine. It must sound like something that would actually get funded.
What is the least emergency-worthy thing you'd genuinely be tempted to call for help about?
You're stuck in a lift for six hours. Who's the best person to be stuck with, and who's the worst?
You're rewriting your country's national anthem as a single sentence. What is it?
Which two fictional characters would have the most boring argument, and what would it be about?
What's the most ridiculous thing you could get permanently banned from, and how would you manage it?
You must get a tattoo chosen by the person to your left. How screwed are you?
You must wear something ridiculous every day for a year but you get paid handsomely. What's the item and what's your price?
You have to defend yourself in a shopping centre using only items from one shop. Which shop are you running into?
You get one sound effect that plays whenever you enter a room. What is it, and when does it become a problem?
Design the worst possible vehicle that would still technically get you to work.
How many five-year-olds could you realistically handle at once? Show your maths.
Invent a new public holiday. What's it celebrating and what's the mandatory tradition?
Write an advert slogan that would immediately destroy the company using it.
You must steal one thing from a museum and you cannot get caught. What are you taking and where does it live now?
Describe the worst possible flatmate using only three habits.
The animals hold a meeting about humans. Which species has the strongest case against us?
Invent a cursed object. The curse must be extremely inconvenient but never actually dangerous.
You're stuck reliving one ordinary day forever. Which day of yours would be the most bearable?
You're a superhero. Your power is genuinely useful but your name is terrible. Give us both.
Food fight breaks out. What's your weapon of choice and what's your strategy?
Sell yourself for a job you're catastrophically unqualified for. One sentence, maximum confidence.
What's the worst gift you could give someone that still technically counts as thoughtful?
You run the world for one day. What's the pettiest law you're passing first?
You become a ghost. Where are you haunting and what's your one signature move?
You're on a cooking show and given one ingredient you hate. What are you making with it?
Give the worst possible advice to someone with a completely normal problem.
Name the band you'd form with the last three people who spoke in this channel. What genre are you?
Which fictional character most deserves to be sued, and on what grounds?
Design a warning sign for your own kitchen, desk, or car. What does it warn people about?
Your emergency kit can contain three completely useless items. Which three are you packing?
What's the worst possible moment for someone's phone to ring? Set the scene.
Your pet, or a pet you'd like, gets a job. What are they doing and are they good at it?
Humans and one other species swap places at the top of the food chain. Which species runs the planet worst?
Invent a sport using only things currently within arm's reach of you.
Your autobiography is out. What's the title and what's the review on the back cover?
